key_notes: Key 1 (t=4.13s): Initial archival pose of bush; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.

Key 4 (t=7.73s): Follow-through and settle of bush with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of bush (4.13s..7.73s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
